# Step 1 — Data Ingestion & Schema Validation

Both CSVs were loaded, enforcing correct column types, and verifying the schema matches the project specification.

```{r data-ingestion}
library(tidyverse)
SA_test <- as_tibble(read_csv2("sentiment_analysis_test.csv"))
SA_train <- as_tibble(read_csv2("sentiment_analysis_train.csv"))
summary(SA_train)
head(SA_train)
```

```{r schema-table, echo=FALSE}
tibble(
  Column         = c("Year","Month","Day","date","time_of_tweet","text","sentiment","platform"),
  Type           = c("int","int","int","Date","factor(3)","chr","factor(3)","factor(3)"),
  Expected_Range = c("2010–2023","1–12","1–31","derived","morning/noon/night","free text","neg/neu/pos","FB/IG/TW"),
  Phase_1_Role   = c("temporal trend","seasonality","granularity","timeline axis","posting rhythm","NLP corpus","target variable","stratification variable")
) |>
  kable(caption = "Schema Reference Table — Training Set") |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped","hover","condensed"), full_width = FALSE)
```

```{r}
slang_map <- c(
  "u" = "you",
  "ur" = "your",
  "imo" = "in my opinion",
  "idk" = "i do not know",
  "omg" = "oh my god",
  "btw" = "by the way"
)

clean_text <- function(x){
  x %>%
    str_to_lower() %>%
    str_replace_all("http[s]?://\\S+|www\\.\\S+", " URL ") %>%
    str_replace_all("@\\w+", " USER ") %>%
    str_replace_all("#(\\w+)", " \\1 ") %>%             # keep hashtag word
    str_replace_all("([!?.,])\\1{1,}", "\\1\\1") %>%   # cap repetition
    str_replace_all("\\b(u|ur|imo|idk|omg|btw)\\b", ~ slang_map[.x]) %>%
    str_squish()
}

cleaning_table <- function(data){
  data$Year <- as.integer(as.character(data$Year))
  data$Month <- as.integer(as.character(data$Month))
  data$Day <- as.integer(as.character(data$Day))
  data$`Time of Tweet` <- factor(data$`Time of Tweet`,  
                                 levels = c("morning","noon","night"))
  data$sentiment <- factor(data$sentiment,
                           levels = c("negative", "neutral", "positive"))
  data$text <- clean_text(data$text)
  data$Platform <- factor(data$Platform)
  data
}

SA_train_cleaned <- cleaning_table(SA_train)
SA_train_cleaned <- SA_train_cleaned %>%
  mutate(date = make_date(Year, Month, Day),
    .after = Day)

summary(SA_train_cleaned)
```

# Step 2 — Structural Data Quality Audit

A data quality procedure must be ensured to justify every decision made in the following steps.

```{r data-quality}
missing_map <- SA_train %>%
  summarise(across(everything(), ~ sum(is.na(.)))) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(), 
               names_to = "column", 
               values_to = "n_missing") %>%
  mutate(pct_missing = round((n_missing / nrow(SA_train)/100),3))

missing_map
```
